chunks: Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

When he proposed marriage to her, Amir al-Mu'minin said to him, 'She is yet a child.' He said that he met al-Abbas and asked him, 'What is wrong with me, is there something wrong with me?' He said, 'What is the matter?' He replied, 'I proposed marriage to the son of your brother for his daughter, but he rejected me. By Allah, I will shut down Zamzam, and I will not leave any honor for you without destroying it, and I will establish two witnesses against him that he stole, and I will cut off his right hand.' So al-Abbas came to him, informed him, and asked him to leave the matter to him, so he left it to him.
ai.seo_question: What was the story behind the marriage of Umm Kulthum bint Ali to al-Abbas?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* details the marriage of Umm al-Banin (Umm Kulthum) to al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib, highlighting the political and familial dynamics within the Prophet's household. The narrative illustrates the Imam's strategic delegation of authority to al-Abbas to manage the proposal and subsequent disputes, emphasizing the importance of lineage and the respect accorded to the Ahl al-Bayt. It serves as a key reference in Shia scholarship for understanding the marital alliances that strengthened the bond between the Prophet's family and the early Muslim community.
